title: crypto2dev: HKDF and PBKDF2 callbacks
description: Implement CryptoCb KDF handlers for HKDF and PBKDF2 via DO_KDF ioctl. Open a fresh fd (not from pool — one-shot), write IKM (for HKDF) or password (for PBKDF2), call DO_KDF ioctl with algo='hkdf(sha256)'/'pbkdf2(sha256)' etc., then read() the derived key material. Return derived key bytes to wolfSSL caller. Do NOT use the resulting KEY fd as a key_fd for INIT — just extract the OKM bytes and close the fd. Map wolfSSL wc_KdfType and hash type to crypto2dev algo strings.
notes: wolfSSL HKDF callback receives: salt, IKM, info, output buffer, output length, hash type. PBKDF2 callback receives: password, salt, iterations, output length, hash type. PBKDF2 minimum salt=16 bytes and iterations>=1000 enforced by crypto2dev — return error if wolfSSL caller passes less.
